economic.needed_fact: Does the app charge any hidden fees for withdrawing the money after the three months, and does it work without expensive mobile data?

runs.primary_objection: Can I trust these people with my contributions?
runs.reaction: I keep my cash hidden in a tin under the bed because if it is in a bank account, I see it and spend it on bread or paraffin before the month ends. This app sounds like it tries to do what my stokvel does, but my stokvel members are my neighbors who know where I live and will shame me if I don't pay. I do not trust a phone screen to hold my money when I have no job and every rand counts for survival. Paying R15 a month is money I cannot lose, especially if the network goes down and I cannot access my own funds during an emergency. I need to know if I can withdraw everything immediately if a child gets sick, because bonuses mean nothing if I starve next week.
